name: Claim denial work list
summary: The billing coordinator gets every denied claim from the practice’s remittance export on one work list, sorted by kind of denial, appeal deadline and amount, with the paperwork each one needs and a short summary of where denials keep starting. Staff decide every appeal.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's own rules for prepared work: the practice's own export and settings as the only authority, every deadline shown with its working, every coding or medical question handed to a named role, and staff who decide every appeal.

sources.contribution: Sorting claim denials by their cause, naming the administrative evidence that certain causes need (proof of timely submission, the authorization record), and reviewing denial patterns by payer and provider for prevention.
